paper: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
reading: Root inspected methods3.1-3.5, experiments4.1-4.3, algorithmB.3, trainingA, leakageE.5. No implementation or paper results reproduced.
task_input: Text prompt, room boundary, asset pool. Planner chooses object groups/composition; not immutable complete-request inventory by default.

mechanism.HRAP: Room/group/anchor statistical prior documents mined from clean scenes; soft prompt augmentation, not copied complete layouts or hard score constraints.
mechanism.RMR: Annotated top+diagonal renders, scene JSON, history -> move/rotate/scale. After each group insertion, editable scope includes new objects and neighbor anchors. Text also describes local search and geometric cleanup beyond policy proposals.
mechanism.Q: Weighted physical PBL, relation REL and function FUNC; candidate accepted only if Q improves. Weighted improvement is not proof each hard constraint improves.
mechanism.training: SceneReverse-17k reverse perturbations; Qwen3-VL-8B; SFT then GRPO. Appendix describes4GPU SFT,2epochs; GRPO trains vision tower with language backbone frozen. Not a training-free prompt pipeline.

paper_evaluation.cohort: 100scenes,5types,75long prompts derived from selected scenes and25short room/count prompts
paper_evaluation.physical: OOB+mesh-level collision MBL=PBL, voxel-based following ReSpace; VR uses a fixed PBL threshold whose exact operational reproduction was not established here.
paper_evaluation.semantic: GPT-5.4 judge LC/SPA/FC plus human study with50validresponses; method-level agreement across3methods is auxiliary, not broad judge calibration.
paper_evaluation.main_results_as_reported: ScenePilot PBL×1000=75.4,VR=.86,judgeAvg8.1; ReSpace186.2,.73,5.7; Reason3D162.2,.66,6.8. Reason3D has lower MBL alone, so do not say ScenePilot best at every component.
paper_evaluation.ablations_as_reported: w/oHRAP PBL135.5,Avg7.0; w/ogroupwise131.2,7.4; w/olearnedRMR123.4,6.4; HRAPonly147.7,5.8. ExpertGPT5.2 repair53.5,.91,8.2 is stronger but only a reference under their setting.
paper_evaluation.uncertainty: No independent runs/CI or same-budget end-to-end timing claim was validated. Do not rank against user screenshot from different protocol.

leakage_boundary: E.5 states evaluation IDs should be excluded before prior mining/indexing. No public split manifest established here; this is an unresolved verification requirement, not a finding that leakage occurred.
code_availability: Author-linked GitHub404 as separately recorded in scenepilot-source-check.json; no accessible exact implementation/weights verified. Homonymous driving projects excluded.
for_fastfill: Test train-only anchor statistics and exact-ID functional grouping without training first; freeze repair while2x2 flat/group and noRAG/RAG. Then compare editor/solver effects with equal compute. Integrate real mesh support/function checks after downstream workflow is known.
